item.title: SCV 101: Patty Hackett & Peggy Honore, SCV Golden Girls
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda talks to Patty Hacket and Peggy Honore from the SCV Golden Girls, an organization that provides financial services to individuals looking to secure their future, protect loved ones, or prepare for retirement. They also talk about S.O.S., Serving Our Seniors, which is an organization that aims to make resources available to senior citizens of Santa Clarita such as transportation, medical assistance, financial planning, and more

item.title: March 14: Honor Cancer Survivors, Caregivers at American Cancer Society’s Celebration Dinner
item.description: Cancer survivors and caregivers are cordially invited to the American Cancer Society's Celebration Dinner March 14 at the Canyon Country Community Center.

item.title: Meet Rome a Handsome Pup from Sunny Day Acres Ready for His Forever Home
item.description: In this adorable segment of SCVTV's Community Corner, Jen Gray, founder of Sunny Day Acres, introduces us to Rome, a handsome Staffordshire Terrier, who's looking for his forever family.
